description: Web extension target (vscode.dev / github.dev): browser bundle from the same entry point, browser test run via @vscode/test-web.

scripts.test:web: npm run compile && node esbuild.mjs --web-tests && vscode-test-web --browserType=chromium --quality stable --headless --extensionDevelopmentPath=. --extensionTestsPath=out/web/test/index.js ./test-fixtures/workspace

agentsNotes: - **Web** (`browser` entry): the same `src/extension.ts` is bundled for the web worker host. Shared code may not import Node built-ins (ESLint + vsx-check BRW-001); Node-only code goes in `src/node/` behind a capability check, and file I/O uses `vscode.workspace.fs`. Run `npm run test:web` before merging changes that touch shared code.
